My daughter, Varnika has an inclination for drawing and I was looking for an art teacher who could introduce her to some sketching and painting techniques. After looking for about 3-4 months I stumbled upon ‘I can paint anything’. They scheduled a zoom meeting. Poonam ma’am spent a good one and half hours running us through a nice presentation and talking not only about our immediate requirement but about the discipline and profession of art in general. It was a lot to take in, but very interesting and promising.

As Varnika spent time on her drawing classes and practice, I could see some visible improvements very quickly. There emerged some structure to her practice.
